name: crms-root
description: VNRVJIET Campus Resource Management System (CRMS) — Root Orchestration

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:main-fe && npm run test:admin-fe
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:main-fe && npm run test:admin-fe && npm run build
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix crms-main-frontend test && npm --prefix crms-admin-frontend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix crms-main-frontend run build && npm --prefix crms-admin-frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix crms-main-frontend run lint && npm --prefix crms-admin-frontend run lint
